Card Q&A.q: Does "This Digimon can't be blocked" in this card's [Start of Your Main Phase] effect activate even when my opponent can't trash a digivolution card?

Card Q&A.a: No, you can't activate it. This card’s inherited effect reads "When this Digimon would be deleted," so it interrupts the deletion when it activates. Therefore, the [Gomamon] with the [On Deletion] effect is removed from the digivolution cards before the [On Deletion] effect can be triggered.
Card Q&A.q: I have both this card and another [Gomamon] with an [On Deletion] inherited effect in the digivolution cards of the same one of my Digimon. When that Digimon is deleted, can I activate this card's inherited effect, play the other [Gomamon] from the digivolution cards, and activate that [On Deletion] inherited effect?

Effect: [Start of Your Main Phase] Trash any 1 digivolution card of 1 of your opponent's Digimon. This Digimon can't be blocked for the turn.
Inherited Effect: [Opponent's Turn] When this Digimon would be deleted, you may play 1 [Gomamon] from its digivolution cards without paying the cost.
